title: Minimax estimation of smooth optimal transport maps
tldr_zh: α-光滑强凸势 Brenier map 的 minimax 率 n^{-2α/(2α-2+d)}∨n^{-1}（log 内），半对偶+截断小波估计器达到；首个一般维度结果
tldr_en: First general-dimension minimax rate n^{-2α/(2α-2+d)} for smooth Brenier maps, attained by a wavelet-restricted empirical semi-dual estimator via a new semi-dual stability bound.
key_numbers: Minimax lower bound E||T̂−T0||²_{L²(P)} ≳ n^{-2α/(2α-2+d)} ∨ 1/n (Thm 6, Eq. 3.1)
Experiments d=3 (id): log-log slopes emp −0.693 / wav −0.913 / ker −1.065 (Fig. 2a); d=10: emp −0.250 / ker −0.666 (Fig. 2b)
Constants scale like M^{c1 d + c2} (Remark 9(v))
